# Work Log format
# This is a template for a work log. It includes the date, and a description of the work done.
# The logs source is from the `git log` command.
# date range from last date to today
# The log is formatted as a markdown table.
# create a folder called `worklogs` in the root of your project if not exist.
# save this file as `{date}_work_log.md` in the `worklogs` folder.


{date} work log:
> use markdown table to format the log
| Date       | Description                                                                 |

> one line per commit per date
| {date} | {commit_message} |

> the content in log.md file should only include the markdown table
> the content in log.md file should not include any other text
